paper_target: Applied Energy VSI: Large models for Next-Generation Energy Systems
scope: Locked model portfolio for the new multi-energy TSFM paper.
rules: This registry controls P2/P3 experiment eligibility and table placement.
A model can be moved to appendix or excluded only with a documented feasibility, license, horizon, runtime or audit reason.
The strong-baseline set is intentionally limited to LightGBM, TFT, N-BEATSx, iTransformer and TimeXer Future-Known to avoid a model zoo while retaining one explicit exogenous-variable Transformer.
The 2025 top-conference TSFM pool supports the large-model audit narrative; it is not the only pool because several models have limited covariate/adaptation support.
The covariate/adaptation pool supports H1 energy-conditioned adaptation and must be evaluated under the same P1c task contract.

All DL/Transformer/TSFM training, validation, testing, fine-tuning, inference, smoke checks, shared-dev runs and backtesting must run on GPU/CUDA; CPU-only DL/TSFM artifacts are ineligible for registry status, P2/P3 summaries and manuscript tables.
LightGBM is the CPU exception: formal LightGBM training/tuning may use about 90% CPU threads; ServerA's 40 logical CPUs imply --n-jobs 36 unless superseded by a documented resource policy.
DL/Transformer/TSFM formal runs should be configured for GPU/CUDA with high utilization, bounded by memory safety, reproducibility and audit requirements.
P2/P3 DL/TSFM artifacts must pass the P2-2ad GPU artifact audit or an equivalent later GPU audit before they can be cited in registry summaries or manuscript tables.
P2/P3 registry-facing artifacts must pass the P2-2ae memory/Markdown consistency audit or an equivalent later consistency audit before P3 handoff.
Cross-model metric comparisons must pass a test-window alignment audit: identical window_id sets, timestamp metadata, and y_true values for the same dataset/task/domain/horizon/split.

chronos2_zero_shot.notes: Chronos-2 without task-specific adaptation, evaluated under the same P1c windows.

chronos2_lora_finetune.notes: Chronos-2 full-power checkpoint with LoRA fine-tuning; P2-2t preflight passed on aluminum_load/4h, P2-2u shared-development scaling passed across all 5 domains x 2 horizons, P2-2v/P2-2w validation-only budget checks selected 128/32 windows, 50 steps and learning rate 5e-5, P2-2x locked a validation WAPE selection rule choosing LoRA for 7 cells and zero-shot for 3 cells, and P2-2y completed selected-route test-once on the shared P2 development subset. The pure all-LoRA route remains separate from the validation-selected route.

timesfm2p0_500m_zero_shot.notes: TimesFM-family full-power target-only zero-shot route, P1c-smoke-passed in P2-2s and shared-dev-passed in P2-2z via transformers.TimesFmModelForPrediction. Prediction/metric artifacts must use artifact_model_id timesfm2p0_500m. Keep separate from TimesFM 2.5 200M XReg/adaptation variants.
timesfm2p0_500m_zero_shot.base_model_id_note: base_model_id points to the shared TimesFM-family registry entry; artifact_model_id timesfm2p0_500m disambiguates this 500M checkpoint from TimesFM 2.5 200M XReg/adaptation artifacts.

timesfm2p5_xreg.notes: TimesFM 2.5 200M with XReg covariate adaptation using known-future calendar features; P1c-smoke-passed in P2-2q and GPU-certified shared-dev-passed in P2-2aa/P2-2ad. Smaller/newer adaptation variant, not the full-power headline route.

timesfm2p5_lora.notes: TimesFM 2.5 200M parameter-efficient adaptation candidate; must be separately audited before formal reporting and must not be conflated with the 2.0 500M full-power zero-shot route.

chronos2_validation_selected_lora_or_zer.notes: Validation-selected Chronos-2 route: LoRA where P2-2w validation WAPE improves over zero-shot, otherwise zero-shot. P2-2y applied the locked rule to test once on the shared P2 development subset; non-selected routes were not predicted on test.
